text:
Rhea: Quick ask 90m - BrightArc wants to keep rwd-70 pinned while they finish a major data migration. They're asking for 8-12 weeks and want discounts. Can we design a reusable 'gracepath' lane (runway + ledger + gates)? cc @Tom @Deepa
Tom: What exact variant and traffic? We need baseline perf + semantic deltas to size the lane.
Deepa: They're pinned to rwd-70-v1, ~95QPS, heavy on na-east, and use embeddings for rerank. Canary diagnostics: semantic diff ~4.2% on their seed set, embedding recall@10 -3pp, p95 +11ms in na-east.
Marcus: TL;DR: 4.2% is above our usual 3% gate for tier-1. Proposal: a three-tier gracepath: short-bridge (14d, no credit), runway-30 (30d, 12% credit), runway-84 (84d, 20% credit + weekly audits). Include a ledger entry for credit consumption and a contract snippet.
Elise: Finance note: any discount >15% requires finance pre-approval and a recorded ledger entry. We prefer staged credits (front-loaded first 30 days) vs flat discounts. Also need credit accounting in billing exports.
Tom: Ops constraints: must require a shadow-serve (48h) and automated rollback webhooks. Canary sequencing: 5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100% and each bump gated by weekly eval snapshot.
Marcus: Draft preflight checklist to gate bump:
```text
- customer-seed eval (semantic pass rate + critical-fallback checks)
- embedding similarity: median cosine delta + recall@k
- p50/p95 perf smoke (per-region)
- shadow-serve telemetry 48h OK
- KV-cache warm & cold-start smoke
- structured-output invariant tests (field presence/order)
- fallback variant exercised and verified
```
Deepa: Add: include a small top-k recall audit for rerank flows specifically (their workload hits rerank hard). Also require an embeddings schema compatibility check so vectors don't shift dimension/order.
Marcus: Bench exit gates per tier (suggested): short-bridge: delta <=3% and perf within +10ms; runway-30: delta <=2% and perf within +6ms; runway-84: delta <=3.5% but requires weekly improvement trend and mitigation plan.
Elise: If we offer 20% for 84d we need to pre-clear finance. Ask: can CS accept staged credit (20% first 30d, 10% next 30d, 0% last 24d) ? That reduces long-term revenue impact.
Rhea: CS prefers a single band but will confirm if staged helps acceptance. They also asked for a guaranteed rollback SLA and weekly status email to the customer.
Tom: Implementation notes: CI job will run weekly evals, post status to the customer channel, and refuse canary bump on fail. I'll add a rollback webhook that ops can trigger. I'll own the webhook.
Marcus: I'll draft the gracepath spec: lanes, canary sequencing, sample SLOs, contract snippet, and a customer comms template (clear rollback language). Assign to me.
Deepa: I'll run the per-segment diagnostics (long-tail vs head) and produce embedding recall breakdown by tomorrow.
billing-bot: FYI - discounts above 15% require finance approval ticket. Please file /approve-discount with proposed ledger entries.
Elise: I'll review the draft contract language and pre-clear finance if we need 20% for the first month. Ping me before sending to the customer.
Rhea: Owners: Marcus (lane spec + comms) & Tom (infra + webhooks). Target internal draft: EOD Wednesday. Customer wants a firm answer within 7 business days. Keep updates short so CS can forward. :hourglass:
